Changes in R<sup>2</sup> and model fit (F-tests) were examined for four nested regression models predicting Mini-Mental State Examination (MMSE), Trail Making Test (TMT)-A, TMT-B, and Digit Symbol Substitution Test (DSST). Base Models included common dementia risk factors. Model-2 = Base + Insomnia Severity Index; Model-3 = Model-2 + dose; Model-4 = Model-3 + OSA risk; and Model-5 = Model-4 + OSA-BZRA.<h4>Results</h4>R<sup>2</sup> for the base model predicting MMSE was 0.139 (n = 313), 0.241 for TMT-A (n = 298), 0.229 for TMT-B (n = 287), and 0.189 for DSST (n = 285). Model-5 R<sup>2</sup> was 0.142 for MMSE, 0.246 for TMT-A, 0.238 for TMT-B, and 0.190 for DSST, with all F-test p-values >.145.<h4>Conclusions</h4>Sleep disorder variables did not significantly explain additional variation in cognition performance. Studies with a wider range of cognitive performance are needed.<h4>Supplementary information</h4>The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s12126-026-09684-6.","affiliation":"University of California Irvine Psychiatry and Human Behavior, Orange, United States.","publicationStatus":"ppublish","language":"eng","pubModel":"Print-Electronic","pubTypeList":{"pubType":["Journal Article"]},"grantsList":{"grant":[{"agency":"NIA NIH HHS","acronym":"AG","grantId":"P30 AG073105","orderIn":0},{"agency":"NIA NIH HHS","acronym":"AG","grantId":"P30 AG059299","orderIn":0},{"agency":"NCATS NIH HHS","acronym":"TR","grantId":"UL1 TR001881","orderIn":0},{"agency":"NIA NIH HHS","acronym":"AG","grantId":"P30 AG073107","orderIn":0},{"agency":"NHLBI NIH HHS","acronym":"HL","grantId":"K24 HL143055","orderIn":0},{"agency":"NIA NIH HHS","acronym":"AG","grantId":"R01 AG057929","orderIn":0},{"agency":"NIA NIH HHS","acronym":"AG","grantId":"K23 AG049955","orderIn":0}]},"keywordList":{"keyword":["Cognition","Sleep","Insomnia","Sleep Apnea","Benzodiazepine"]},"fullTextUrlList":{"fullTextUrl":[{"availability":"Subscription required","availabilityCode":"S","documentStyle":"doi","site":"DOI","url":"https://doi.org/10.1007/s12126-026-09684-6"}]},"isOpenAccess":"N","inEPMC":"N","inPMC":"N","citedByCount":0,"hasReferences":"Y","hasTextMinedTerms":"Y","hasDbCrossReferences":"N","hasPDF":"N","hasBook":"N","hasSuppl":"N","hasLabsLinks":"N","hasData":"N","license":"cc by","authMan":"N","epmcAuthMan":"N","nihAuthMan":"N","hasTMAccessionNumbers":"N","dateOfCompletion":"2026-10-31","dateOfCreation":"2026-10-31","dateOfRevision":"2026-11-01","electronicPublicationDate":"2026-10-29","firstPublicationDate":"2026-10-29","firstIndexDate":"2026-11-01","hasEvaluations":"N"}]}}
